title: ficus globosa var. manok
intro: Ficus globosa var. manok, commonly known as the Manok or Bunga Manok, is a plant species that is native to the tropical regions of Southeast Asia. It is traditionally used in folk medicine to treat various health conditions, including fever, cough, and inflammation, due to its numerous health benefits, such as antimicrobial, anti-inflammatory, and antioxidant properties. The Manok plant is also used for its therapeutic actions, including antipyretic, analgesic, and expectorant properties, which help to reduce fever, relieve pain, and clear mucus from the respiratory tract. The bioactive constituents of Ficus globosa var. manok include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
